meta.name: outputs
meta.description: The output contract (178, plan 170 L4, jav/outputs/contract.py): each output a person downloads or a release stores, and the data it is filled with: its values (one value each, such as the package's name) and its tables, each column with its kind. A key is an English identifier (lowercase letters, digits and `_`); a person's own template (planned: the second round of L4) may use only the keys listed here. A table with `per` is one table for each document type, its columns the listed ones followed by the type pack's fields (`fields: type_pack`) or the columns of its lists' rows (`fields: type_pack_lists`); `months` adds one column per month, keyed `month_<yyyy>_<mm>`. Kinds: text, date, money and number (a decimal number; written as one when the text reads as one), count (a whole number), probability (between 0 and 1), flag (yes or empty), json (structured text). builtin: the layout of the built-in template, the one every download had until 178 (sheet per table; `heading`: the values as a block above every table; `min_width`: the narrowest column; `marks`: the fill colour of a marked cell). The column headers and sheet names of the built-in layout come from field_labels.json, reports.json and the code that builds the data.

changelog.note: 178 (plan 170 L4): first version, from the two downloads of today: a package's result (also a run's) and a reconciliation package's statement.

package_result.what: The result of a package or of one of its runs: the native facts and readings, the emails and their tasks, the documents by type, their data points and line items, and the utility cost by month.

reconcile_statement.what: A reconciliation package's statement: its own invoices and its statement lines, each with its result, under a heading naming the package, its party, period, accounts and version.
